brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road. In Chapter 13, Jemmy runs into a bear in a forest clearing. Build the clearing, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each sentence and decide: is it in the book, or not? Then finish two sentences about the prince.
extra: Find a big tree. Pretend it is hollow, like Jemmy’s. Say why it was a smart place to hide.
step1: These are your four models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the bear in an open spot. Put the rope and the bee by the bear. Put the horse off to the side.
step4: Point to the horse and say this out loud. The prince won’t go back with the soldiers because… I know because…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
